svg.title: AWS Spring Boot Module Architecture
svg.desc: Spring Boot 4 auto-configuration layers for AWS SDK v2 clients, coroutine operations, listener containers, repositories, environment sources, Exposed database registry, and runtime AWS services.
svg.text: Spring Boot 4 auto-configuration without awspring: SDK v2 clients, coroutine operations, listeners, repositories, and config sources.

g.text: No awspring runtime dependency. AWS service SDKs are compileOnly here; applications add only the runtime services they use.

svg.text: created beans call selected AWS SDK clients
runtime dependency choice stays with the application
